$comment: Template for the 10-document ground truth. Values are placeholders. file: path relative to data/, folder = category. summary: one string for the whole document. classification: one entry per page, numbered from 1; each label must match a classificationCategories name exactly. extraction: values keyed by the names in fields; null when the document does not contain the field. A job left out of a document is not sent for it.
